answer: New identities earn voting rights only after the registry mails a one-time code to a physical address nothing else has ever claimed. Two names activated from one mailbox freeze both, and the younger forfeits its 8,000 POA deposit. Every fake therefore needs its own rented box at twenty-five dollars a month, leaving a hundred clones to sink thirty thousand dollars a year while letters wander through customs before their first emission; an honest agent activates once from its shale-country office and guards its onyx-sealed code.
